# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/PathGao/kururu/security/advisories/new).
Keep vulnerability details out of public issues, pull requests and discussions.

Include the impact, reproduction steps or a proof of concept, and your kururu
and macOS versions. Security fixes target the latest release. Give the maintainer
time to investigate and ship a fix before public disclosure; reporters can
request credit. This community project does not promise a response time.

Reports should concern kururu's integrity, local data, misuse of its permissions
or release/update integrity. Report issues in external services to their providers.
Official releases from v0.1.2 use Apple Developer ID signing and notarization.
